name: GOV Notify Integration
description: Enables integration with gov notify messaging services (eg Gov.UK Notify, Gov CA Notifications, Gov AU Notify)
project_description:
This module enables you to send emails and SMS messages from Drupal using the UK, Canadian or Australian Government's Notify service. It registers a 'govuk_notify_mail' Mail plugin so ordinary Drupal system emails (and any programmatic mail) can be routed through Notify, using either a Drupal-rendered 'default' template with ((subject))/((message)) placeholders or a specific Notify template. Government Notify services are highly-available, scalable notifications platforms for use by Government departments and agencies.

 https://www.notifications.service.gov.uk 
 https://digital.canada.ca/2019/11/26/introducing-notify 

 Installation documentation is available at https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/modules/govuk-notify/installation
